note: Single meeting, in person at Town Hall with a Zoom broadcast. Seven votes on Annual Town Meeting articles and consent calendar, plus adjournment. Only Article 6 has a printed count (6-1); the others are recorded as carried unanimously. Article 9's proposal to pull the stabilization articles from the consent calendar has no separate vote; the consent calendar motion covers it. Select Board Chairperson Tom Alonzo is named as attending a separate meeting with Town Counsel, not this one, so he is not listed as an attendee. Minutes print no document list; the warrant articles named are listed as text references.

budget_items.topic: Stabilization fund articles in the consent calendar
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Beardmore raised concern that voting on financial articles outside the consent calendar could affect the stabilization fund articles inside it, and proposed removing those articles from the consent calendar; no separate vote on that proposal is recorded.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of whether the capital plan article asks Town Meeting to appropriate money or to change the plan; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the way the capital plan article is written, is to see if the town will appropriate the money, not to see if they'll change the plan
